text: Annette McRae for Utah Senate District 20
⚡ Energy & Infrastructure Expand Basin refining. Capture gas instead of flaring. Treat produced water as infrastructure. Well-to-wheel stability: keep the value here. Learn More →
🌾 Agriculture Farmers grow the food. Communities need the food. Infrastructure connects the two. Keep farm value in the district, not on someone else’s highway. Learn More →
🏠 Housing + Water Housing never stands alone. Every approval must connect to water capacity and transportation access. Design first. Density after. Learn More →
💧 Water First Complete Basin water projects. Align housing with real water modeling. Protect senior ag rights. Water security is structural, not political. Learn More →
🚂 Rail & Transportation Freight rail decouples Basin highway risk. Passenger rail reduces Wasatch Back canyon congestion. Rail is risk reduction, not job elimination. Learn More →
🚨 Public Safety When authority is shared, coordination must be pre-planned. Cross-agency. Tribal, state, and federal. Time matters more than turf. Learn More →
